AblativePlating.description: Any incoming <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> with less than <style="Piercing_Ratio">{[pierceRatio]}% Pierce Ratio</style> must go through <style="Stat_Armor">Armour</style> three times. Does not apply to <style="Stat_CritDamage">Crits</style>.

AdaptiveToxins.description: Each unit hit by the Hive Tyrant in melee suffers a <style="Stat_Armor">-{[armorReduction]} Armour</style> reduction for the rest of the battle.

AdrenalSurge.description: Each time the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Screamer-Killer</style> defeats an enemy, it gains <style="Stat">+{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance</style> until the end of the battle.

AlphaWarrior.description:
If the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Winged Prime</style> has not moved this turn, summons a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Tyranids">Tyranid Warrior</style></style> on a free hex within <style="Synapse">Synapse</style> range. The <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Tyranids">Tyranid Warrior</style></style> cannot move this turn, but can immediately perform a <style="NormalAttack">normal attack</style> against an enemy in range.

Tyranid Warrior stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

AnnihilatorBeam.description: <style="Faction_Necrons">Szarekh</style> triggers his <style="Faction_Necrons">Triarchal Menhirs</style> to fire on {[nrOfTargets]} hexes. These hexes light up with light pillars and at the start of <style="Faction_Necrons">Szarekh</style>'s next turn any unit in those hexes is dealt <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Piercing">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage</style>.

ArcaneShield.description:
After moving, <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Thaumachus</style> applies a <style="Buff_Shield">Shield</style> to the closest friendly unit within {[range]} hexes, preferring <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Thousand Sons</style> units, then other <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> units, then other friendly units, and lastly casting it on himself if there is no other valid target. The shield has <style="Stat_Health">{[shieldHp]} Health</style> and lasts one round.

If <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Thaumachus</style> does not move, then this ability triggers at the end of his turn.

ArchContaminator.description:
At the beginning of his turn all adjacent enemies take <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Toxic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage</style> plus each <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style> also deals extra <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> equal to {[extraDmgPct]}-{[extraDmgPct_2]}% of the unit's max <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>. <style="Summon">Summons</style> take double damage.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

ArcScourge.description: Attacks an enemy unit within {[range]} hexes. Up to {[maxAdjacentTargets]} additional units adjacent to each other are also hit, including friendly units. Enemy units that are hit receive {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Molecular Damage and if they are Mechanical, they are also Stunned for 1 round. For each mechanical unit hit, Belisarius Cawl gains {[effectLevel]} level of Machine Vengeance. After using Arc Scourge, Belisarius Cawl can immediately use another action.

ArmouredMight.description: This unit’s movement is not blocked by other units, instead they get <style="Displacement">pushed</style> and take <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Melta">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Melta Damage</style>. <style="Summon">Summons</style> and units that cannot be displaced are automatically defeated, and all units defeated by this ability are <style="Obliterated">always overkilled</style>.

ATemptingTrap.description:
<style="Faction_Tau">Sho'Syl</style> receives <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> from all attacks, but loses <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style> each time he is damaged by a melee attack. At the start of his third turn, he summons <style="STAT">{[nrOfSummons]}</style> <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Tau">Stealth Battlesuits</style></style> plus an additional Battlesuit for each enemy unit on the battlefield. The summoned units immediately take a turn.

Stealth Battlesuit stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

AttemptedPossession.description: Target an enemy within {[range]} hexes. The target and any <style="Summon">Summons</style> it has summoned become possessed and immediately perform a <style="NormalAttack">normal attack</style> against the closest enemy unit, preferring unpossessed targets. Possessed units deal <style="Stat">{[dmgPct]}%</style> of their own <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> to a maximum of <style="Stat_Damage">{[maxDmg]} Damage</style> per <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style>. Possessed <style="Summon">Summons</style> will move before attacking.

BasiliskBarrage.description:
If <style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Thaddeus Noble</style> has not moved, unleashes a barrage of {[nrOfProjectiles]} shells on any target on the battlefield, each dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style>. {[nrOfProjectiles_2]} randomly hit the target hex or surrounding hexes and the remaining 2 hit the hexes surrounding those. For each round that has ended, 1 more of the shells hits the target hex, starting with the shells hitting the outer hexes. The <style="Suppressive_Fire">Suppressive Fire</style> trait applies also to this ability.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

BioBarrage.description: The Tervigon itself and all friendly units deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% ranged <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> if they did not move in their turn.

BladeOfMagnus.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> to a target enemy within <style="Stat">2</style> hexes and all enemies adjacent to it. This damage is increased by <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> if the affected units are on <style="Effect_Fire">Fire</style> hexes.

BlisteringAssault.description: The <style="Faction_Tyranids">Screamer-Killer</style>'s <style="NormalAttack">normal attacks</style> also affect all enemies adjacent to the target of the attack.

BloodRunsAngerRisesWarCallsReworked.description:
At the end of the <style="Faction_Aeldari">Avatar of Khaine</style>'s turn, if there are less than <style="Stat">{[nrOfUnits]}</style> <style="Faction_Aeldari">Guardian Defenders</style> on the battlefield, he summons <style="Stat">2</style> <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Aeldari">Guardian Defenders</style></style> at one of the battlefield corners. 

Guardian Defender stats
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

BookOfFate.description: After the relic bearer performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal attack</style>, a friendly adjacent <style="Summon">Summon</style> performs a normal attack against an enemy in range, if possible. If the summon is a <style="Daemon">Daemon</style>, it deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> with this attack.

BossAdjutant.description: This unit takes <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgPctReduction]}% Damage</style>. Each time this unit is dealt damage, up to <style="Stat">{[nrOfAttacks]}</style> times per turn, it loses <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style> in addition to the damage done.

BreathOfSilence.description: <style="Faction_Necrons">Szarekh</style> summons {[nrOfSummons]} <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Necrons">Deathmarks</style></style> on free hexes within range {[range]} from his throne starting hex.

BroodProgenitor.description: Termagants in adjacent hexes deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> in their ranged attacks

CalibaniteGreatsword.description: Forcas can switch between two stances. Strike Stance: At the end of his turn, Forcas starts Overwatching, even if he attacked in his turn. When defeating a unit while Overwatching, he remains in Overwatch, retaining {[nrOfHits]} fewer hits compared to the previous attack. Sweep Stance: Forcas' normal attacks also deal {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to each enemy adjacent to both Forcas and the initial target. This ability can be used once per turn; each use switches the active Stance and does not end Forcas' turn. Only the first use of this ability in each battle counts as using an active ability.

CallRipperSwarms.description:
Summons <style="Stat">{[nrOfSummons]}</style> burrowing <style="Summon">Ripper Swarms</style>, who emerge from the ground at the beginning of the Hive Tyrant's next turn, unless their hex is occupied by another unit

Ripper Swarms' stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

CallRipperSwarms2.description:
Summons <style="Stat">{[nrOfSummons]}</style> burrowing <style="Summon">Ripper Swarms</style>, who emerge from the ground at the beginning of the Hive Tyrant's next turn, unless their hex is occupied by another unit

Ripper Swarms' stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

CallRipperSwarms3.description:
Summons <style="Stat">{[nrOfSummons]}</style> burrowing <style="Summon">Ripper Swarms</style>, who emerge from the ground at the beginning of the Hive Tyrant's next turn, unless their hex is occupied by another unit

Ripper Swarms' stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

Catalyst.description: All friendly <style="Faction_Tyranids">Tyranid</style> units get <style="Stat_Armor">+{[extraArmor]} Armour</style> and a <style="Stat_Chance">{[blockChance]}% chance</style> to <style="Stat_Block">Block {[blockDmg]} Damage</style> for the rest of this turn and the coming enemy turn.

ControlEdict.description:
While Protector Imperative is active: After <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Tan Gi’da</style> attacks, summon a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Skitarii Vanguard</style></style> in a free adjacent hex. Cannot have more than <style="Stat">{[maxSummons]}</style> <style="Summon"><style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Skitarii Vanguards</style></style> summoned this way at the same time.

While Conqueror Imperative is active: After <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Tan Gi’da</style> attacks, all friendly adjacent <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> <style="Summon">Summons</style> also immediately attack his target if it is within range.

Skitarii Vanguard stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

CordClaw.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Direct">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage</style> to an adjacent enemy. All of <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Exitor-Rho</style>’s further attacks until the end of its next turn deal an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Direct">{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Direct Damage</style>.

CursedPlagueBell.description: Friendly <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> units starting their turn within <style="Faction_DeathGuard">Corrodius'</style> <style="ContagionsOfNurgle">Contagion</style> aura gain <style="Stat_Movement">+{[extraMovement]} Movement</style> for this turn. Enemy <style="Psyker">Psyker</style> units within <style="Faction_DeathGuard">Corrodius'</style> <style="ContagionsOfNurgle">Contagion</style> aura deal <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[dmg]} Psychic Damage</style> to themselves each time one of their attacks deals <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic Damage</style>.

CyclicIonBlaster.description:
All attacks deal an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Particle">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Particle Damage</style>.
If the target has a <style="Debuff_Markerlight">Markerlight</style> or the <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> trait these hits deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style>.

DaBossIsWatchin.description: Adjacent <style="Faction_Orks">Orks</style> ignore <style="Battle_Fatigue">Battle Fatigue</style> and deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style>.

DaGreatWaaagh.description: <style="Faction_Orks">Ghazghkull</style> summons <style="Stat">{[nrOfSummons_2]}</style> <style="Summon2">Stormboy</style> for each enemy on the map plus <style="Stat">{[nrOfSummons]}</style> additional <style="Summon">Ork Boyz</style>, who appear on free hexes near the top of the map. Then each <style="Faction_Orks">Ork</style> takes a normal turn, gaining <style="Stat_Movement">+{[extraMovement]} Movement</style> and <style="Stat_Hits">+{[extraHit]} hit</style> on their <style="Stat_Melee">melee</style> attacks this turn.

DakkaDakkaDakka.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Projectile">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage</style> to an enemy within range {[range]}. Adds <style="Stat_Hits">+{[extraHits]}</style> hits for each time <style="Faction_Orks">Snappawrecka</style> was <style="Repairing">repaired</style> this battle, but cannot exceed <style="Stat_Hits">{[maxNrOfHits]} hits</style> in total. If the target is defeated, leftover hits are allocated to random enemies within {[range_2]} hexes. <style="Faction_Orks">Snappawrecka</style> also loses <style="Stat">{[healthPct]}%</style> of his maximum <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>.

DeathScream.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Plasma">{[dmg]} Plasma Damage</style> to a target enemy within range {[range]} and <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Bio">{[dmg_2]} Bio Damage</style> to all enemies adjacent to the target. <style="Stat">{[stunChance]}% chance</style> to <style="Debuff_Stunned">Stun</style> all affected units for 1 round.

Deathwing.description: Each time Baraqiel blocks damage during an attack, all further incoming damage is reduced by {[dmgReduction]} and the damage Baraqiel deals with melee or Plasma Cannon attacks is increased by {[extraDmg]} for 1 round. This effect is doubled against Chaos enemies or when standing adjacent to another friendly Dark Angel.

DefendTheDivineWork.description: <style="Repairing">Repairs</style> himself and all friendly adjacent units <style="Stat_Health">{[hpToRepair]} Health</style>.

DoctrinaImperatives.description: Tan Gi’da switches between two Imperatives that affect him and all friendly adjacent Mechanical units: Protector Imperative: Affected units have +{[extraArmor]} Armour. Conqueror Imperative: Affected units deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage against units with reduced Armour. This ability can be used once per turn instead of once per battle; each use switches the active Imperative. Tan Gi’da can attack after using this ability. Only the first use of this ability each battle counts as using an active ability.

Doom.description: All enemy units exactly {[range]} hexes away from <style="Faction_Aeldari">Eldryon</style> take <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> from other friendly unit's <style="NormalAttack">normal attacks</style>. Other friendly <style="Faction_Aeldari">Aeldari</style> units deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg_2]} Damage</style> with all their attacks to affected units instead.

EarlyWarningOverride.description:
Summons 2 <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Tau">Shield Drones</style></style> into free adjacent hexes. Newly summoned <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Tau">Shield Drones</style></style> can immediately attack an enemy in <style="Stat_Melee">melee</style>, but cannot move this turn.
<style="Faction_Tau">Re'vas</style> also starts <style="Buff_Overwatching">Overwatching</style> until the start of her next turn, dealing <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style>. When defeating a unit while <style="Buff_Overwatching">Overwatching</style>, she remains in <style="Buff_Overwatching">Overwatch</style>, retaining {[hitsReduction]} fewer <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style> compared to the previous attack. 

Shield Drones' stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

EnmityForTheUnworthy.description: <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Forcas</style> deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style> for each adjacent unit and additionally <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> for each adjacent friendly <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Dark Angel</style>.

EreWeGo.description: <style="Faction_Orks">Ghazghkull</style> faces in one of 6 directions and prepares to charge out to range {[range]} in front of him. At the start of his next turn he charges along that path, leaving devastation in his wake. Enemy <style="Summon">Summons</style> in the path are automatically defeated. Each enemy <style="Character">Character</style> on the path takes <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Direct">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage</style> and is <style="Debuff_Stunned">Stunned</style> for 1 round. <style="Faction_Orks">Orks</style> in the path also get <style="Debuff_Stunned">Stunned</style> for 1 round but take no Damage. All units defeated by this ability are <style="Obliterated">always overkilled</style>.

Executioner.description: An enemy target within range {[range]} takes <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> for each round that has started. If the target is eliminated, then an adjacent enemy unit also takes <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> for each round that has started.

Fealty.description: When <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Lion El'Jonson</style> performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attack</style>, he also deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style={[DamageProfileTypeStyle]}>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} {[DamageProfileType]}</style> to all enemies adjacent to both the target of the attack and to Lion El'Jonson.

FieldsOfFire.description: Friendly units with the <style="Emplacement">Emplacement</style> trait deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style> against units that are {[range]} or more hexes away from their own hex. Each time <style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Thaddeus Noble</style> is attacked in <style="Stat_Melee">melee</style> or would get <style="Debuff_Stunned">Stunned</style>, he loses <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style> in addition to the damage done. The first time each round he loses <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> this way, all friendly <style="Emplacement">Emplacement</style> units get <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style> for 1 round.

FlailSwing.description: Performs a melee attack dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to the target and triggering Haze of Corruption if the target is defeated. Any unit defeated by this attack or its add-on attacks from Haze of Corruption is always overkilled.

GalvanicField.description: Whenever <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Actus</style> <style="Repairing">repairs</style> another unit, that unit immediately attacks a target in range, dealing <style="Stat">{[dmgPct]}%</style> of its own <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> to a maximum of <style="Stat_Damage">{[maxDmg]} Damage</style> per <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style>. <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Actus</style> can <style="Repairing">repair</style> other friendly units even if they are at full <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>.

GazeOfMagnus.description:
At the end of each of his turns, <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Magnus</style> turns his Gaze upon an enemy <style="Character">Character</style>, choosing a <style="Psyker">Psyker</style> if possible. At the beginning of Magnus' next turn, if that character is a Psyker or attacked Magnus while under the Gaze, it takes <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x </style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> and if it is a Psyker, it is <style="Debuff_Stunned">Stunned</style> for 1 round. Scores <style="Stat_Hits">+{[extraHit]}x hit</style> for each turn in a row that Magnus targets the same character with the Gaze.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

GetEmRuntz.description:
Summons 1 <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Orks">Grot</style></style> in each adjacent hex that also has an enemy unit adjacent to it. Newly spawned <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Orks">Grots</style></style> can immediately attack an enemy in <style="Stat_Melee">melee</style>, but cannot move this turn. Enemy units attacked by a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Orks">Grot</style></style> this way are <style="Debuff_Taunted">Taunted</style> for 1 round.

Grot’s stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>

GrotTank.description:
Calls in a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Orks">Grot Tank</style></style> in an adjacent free hex. The <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Orks">Grot Tank</style></style> cannot move in its first turn, but can immediately attack an enemy in range.

Grot Tank’s stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style> +<style="Stat_Health">{[extraHp]}</style> for each round that has started
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

GunnersKillOnSight.description: Marks an area in front of the <style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Rogal Dorn Battle Tank</style> for 1 round. Whenever an enemy unit without <style="Infiltrate">Infiltrate</style> ends a move on a marked hex or before it moves out of the marked area, the <style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Rogal Dorn Battle Tank</style> deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Projectile">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage</style> to all units in the area. The ability ends early after <style="Stat">{[nrOfCrits]}</style> attacks against the <style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Rogal Dorn Battle Tank</style> have scored a <style="Stat_CritDamage">Crit</style>.

HazeOfCorruption.description: When <style="Faction_DeathGuard">{[UnitName]}</style> attacks and defeats a unit, any leftover <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> and an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Toxic">{[extraDmg]} Toxic Damage</style> is dealt to a random enemy adjacent to both {[UnitName]} and his initial target. If this unit is also defeated, this ability triggers again, dealing <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> to an additional unit adjacent to both {[UnitName]} and his initial target.

HeavyGravCannon.description: Ranged attacks against <style="Mk_Gravis">MK X Gravis</style>, <style="Terminator_Armor">Terminator Armour</style> or <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> units deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> and have <style="Piercing_Ratio">+{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio</style>.

HostOfPlagues.description: Whenever a non-<style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> enemy unit dies there is a <style="Stat_Chance">{[chance]}% chance</style> a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_DeathGuard">Poxwalker</style></style> is spawned on the hex where that unit died.

HuntTheFallen.description: At the start of the battle, a random enemy Chaos unit is identified as Fallen. If there is no Chaos unit, a random enemy unit is designated as Deathwing Quarry. All friendly Dark Angels deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage to Fallen. Each time Baraqiel is attacked by a Fallen, he loses {[hp_2]} Health in addition to the damage done, or {[hp]} Health if attacked by Deathwing Quarry. Baraqiel takes -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage from all other attacks.

HyperAggression.description: Beginning on its second turn, after the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Screamer-Killer</style> uses an active ability, it also performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal attack</style>.

IllusionsOfTzeentch.description: At the start of the battle, creates a copy of the enemy team to fight for him. Copies have the same stats and ability levels as the original units. As long as one of these copies is on the battlefield, reduce all incoming damage to <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Thaumachus</style> by <style="Stat_Damage">{[dmgReductionPct]}%</style>. Each time a copied character is defeated for the first time, Thaumachus loses <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style>.

ImpossibleForm.description: Each turn, the 9th attack and every 9th additional attack against <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Magnus</style> deal <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style>.

InfernalPacts.description: Friendly <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> units adjacent to <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Abraxas</style> deal an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> with their <style="NormalAttack">normal ranged attacks</style>. Affected <style="Daemon">Daemons</style> also gain the bonus <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style> on their <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attack</style>.

InstrumentsOfVengeance.description:
<style="Faction_DarkAngels">Lion El'Jonson</style> marks hexes in two straight lines, originating from the edges of the battlefield. At the end of this turn, if there is no enemy unit adjacent to Lion El'Jonson, he starts <style="Buff_Overwatching">Overwatching</style>. At the beginning of his next turn, all enemies on marked hexes take <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style={[DamageProfileTypeStyle]}>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} {[DamageProfileType]}</style>. Lion El'Jonson then summons <style="STAT">{[nrOfSummons]}</style> <style="Summon"><style="Faction_DarkAngels">Deathwing Knights</style></style> in free hexes on the battlefield. They can immediately attack enemies in range, but cannot move this turn.

Deathwing Knight stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

InvocationOfMachineVengeance.description:

Then adds <style="Stat">{[effectLevel]}</style> level of <style="Buff_MachineVengeance">Machine Vengeance</style> to all friendly <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> units on the battlefield.

Tech-Priest Enginseer stats:

KardiocoreGalvanus.description: The relic bearer deals <style="Stat_CritDamage">+{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage</style> for each friendly adjacent <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> unit.

KustomForceFieldReworked.description: All friendly adjacent units have <style="Stat_Armor">+{[extraArmor]} Armour</style>. <style="Faction_Orks">Gibbascrapz</style> and other friendly adjacent <style="Faction_Orks">Orks</style> have <style="Stat_Armor">+{[extraArmor_2]} Armour</style> instead and ignore <style="Battle_Fatigue">Battle Fatigue</style>, if they have it.

LethalMiasma.description: At the start of the Tervigon’s turn, any adjacent enemy units suffer <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Direct">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage</style>.

LivingBatteringRam.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Physical">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage</style> to an adjacent target with a <style="Stat">{[stunChance]}% chance</style> to <style="Debuff_Stunned">stun</style> it for 1 round. The target is also <style="Displacement">thrown</style> 2 hexes away from the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Screamer-Killer</style>. If the hex the target lands in was occupied, the occupying unit will be <style="Displacement">pushed</style> 1 hex in a random direction. The target is then dealt an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Direct">{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Direct Damage</style>, regardless if it was thrown or not.

Loki_SwoopingHawk.description:
Flies over and deals a wave of damage from an initial melee target to targets up to 2 hexes behind. <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Piercing">{[dmg[0]]} Piercing Damage</style> to first target, <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Piercing">{[dmg[1]]} Piercing Damage</style> to the second, and <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Piercing">{[dmg[2]]} Piercing Damage</style> to the third. Lands in the hex directly behind the last target hit, or - in case that hex is occupied - to the closest free hex to it.

MartialExemplar.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style={[DamageProfileTypeStyle]}>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} {[DamageProfileType]}</style> to all adjacent enemies. Then moves up to {[nrOfTiles]} hex towards the closest enemy unit and performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal attack</style>. These attacks and all further attacks this turn have <style="Stat">+{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance</style> against <style="Summon">Summons</style>.

MassiveScythingTalons.description: When the Tervigon attacks an enemy in melee, any enemy units adjacent to that target and to the Tervigon take <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Bio">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bio Damage</style>.

MasterOfTheTutelaries.description:
Summon a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_ThousandSons">Pink Horror</style></style> on a free hex adjacent to <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Abraxas</style>. Until the end of this turn, whenever an enemy unit is dealt <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic Damage</style>, summon a <style="Summon2"><style="Faction_ThousandSons">Screamer of Tzeentch</style></style> on a free hex adjacent to <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Abraxas</style>, preferring hexes adjacent to enemy units. Newly summoned units can immediately attack an enemy in range but cannot move.

Pink Horror stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>

Screamer of Tzeentch stats:

<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg_2]} Damage</style>

MoltenForm.description: <style="DMG_Flame">Flame</style>, <style="DMG_Plasma">Plasma</style>, and <style="DMG_Melta">Melta</style> Damage against the <style="Faction_Aeldari">Avatar of Khaine</style> is reduced by <style="Stat_Damage">{[dmgPctReduction]}%</style>.

MortarionsPlagueWind.description:
Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> to a target within {[range]} hexes. Any enemies adjacent to the initial target take <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Psychic Damage</style>. Any further enemies adjacent to at least one secondary target take <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg_3]}-{[maxDmg_3]} Psychic Damage</style>. <style="Summon">Summons</style> take double damage.

MultiTracker.description: All enemy units that did not move during their turn receive a <style="Debuff_Markerlight">Markerlight</style>.

MV71SniperDroneSquad.description:
Instead of a ranged attack, <style="Faction_Tau">Sho'syl</style> summons a <style="Summon">MV71 Sniper Drone</style> and commands it to attack the target. This attack uses <style="Faction_Tau">Sho'syl's</style> <style="Stat_Damage">Damage stat</style>, while other effects, like buffs, are taken from the Drone. If <style="Faction_Tau">Sho'syl</style> already controls {[maxSummons]} <style="Summon">MV71 Sniper Drones</style>, the one with the lowest <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> is removed before the new Drone is summoned.
The target also gains a <style="Debuff_Markerlight">Markerlight</style> until the end of <style="Faction_Tau">Sho'syl's</style> next turn.

MV71 Sniper Drones' stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

MyWillBeDone.description: Immediately trigger one attack by each friendly <style="Faction_Necrons">Necron</style> unit on the battlefield from their current hex and as long as they have a target in range.

NeedsMoreDakka.description: <style="Faction_Orks">Ghazghkull</style> faces in one of 6 directions and loads up Mork's Roar as he prepares to open fire on an area in range {[range]} in front of him. At the beginning of his next turn, all units in the marked area receive <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Projectile">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage</style> while he unleashes an intense hail of bullets. Targets adjacent to <style="Faction_Orks">Ghazghkull</style> receive <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> additional hits. Friendly Orks receive <style="Stat_Hits">{[hitsReductionPct]}%</style> fewer hits.

NetherRealmCasket.description: The relic bearer takes <style="Stat_CritDamage">-{[critDmgReduction]} Crit Damage</style> for each adjacent friendly <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> unit and <style="Regenerate">regenerates</style> an additional  <style="Stat_Health">{[hpToHeal]} Health</style> from <style="Living_Metal">Living Metal</style>.

Neuroparasite.description:
Each enemy that is dealt <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic Damage</style> by the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Neurothrope</style> is infected by a <style="Debuff_Neuroparasite">Neuroparasite</style> until either the unit is healed or the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Neurothrope</style> is defeated. Whenever a unit infected with a <style="Debuff_Neuroparasite">Neuroparasite</style> takes <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic Damage</style> or becomes affected by an attack or ability that would <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppress</style> it, the level of the <style="Debuff_Neuroparasite">Neuroparasite</style> increases by 1, up to a maximum of <style="STAT">{[buffMaxLevel]}</style>.

<style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic Damage</style> dealt by the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Neurothrope</style> is increased by <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> for each level of a <style="Debuff_Neuroparasite">Neuroparasite</style> on the target.

Nightshroud.description: All friendly units starting their turn adjacent to <style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Sibyll Devine</style> gain <style="Buff_Infiltrate">Infiltrate</style> for that turn and take <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReduction]} Damage</style> from each hit in their and the next enemy turn.

NoctilithBeacons.description: <style="Faction_Necrons">Szarekh</style> and all <style="Faction_Necrons">Necrons</style> adjacent to him take <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgPctReduction]}% Damage</style> from all enemies with the <style="Psyker">Psyker</style> trait.

NovaBoost.description: Marks all hexes adjacent to the <style="Faction_Tau">Riptide</style>. <style="Tile_Trench">Trenches</style> cannot be marked. At the beginning of its next turn, the Riptide deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Particle">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Particle Damage</style> to each enemy on marked hexes and then flies to a new location on the battlefield.

NovaCharge.description: Faces in one of 6 directions and marks all hexes in a 3-tile wide line, originating from the <style="Faction_Tau">Riptide</style> and additionally marks {[nrOfTargets]} hexes that are not on this line. <style="Tile_Trench">Trenches</style> cannot be marked. At the beginning of the Riptide's next turn, it deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Particle">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Particle Damage</style> to all enemies on the hexes marked by the line, and <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Blast Damage</style> to all enemies on the other marked hexes.

NovaShield.description: The <style="Faction_Tau">Riptide</style> gains a <style="Buff_Shield">Shield</style> with <style="Stat_Health">{[shieldHp]} Health</style> and receives <style="Stat_Chance">+{[blockChance]}% Block chance</style> for {[nrOfRounds]} round. It then marks a hex on the battlefield and all hexes adjacent to it. <style="Tile_Trench">Trenches</style> cannot be marked. At the beginning of its next turn, the Riptide deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Particle">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Particle Damage</style> to all enemies on marked hexes.

ObeisanceGenerators.description:
Enemy units <style="Charging">charging</style> <style="Faction_Necrons">Szarekh</style> score <style="Stat_Hits">-{[hitsReduction]}</style> hits, to a minimum of 1 hit.
<style="Summon">Summons</style> <style="Charging">charging</style> <style="Faction_Necrons">Szarekh</style> score <style="Stat_Hits">-{[hitsReduction_2]}</style> hits, to a minimum of 1 hit.

OptimizedGait.description: Whenever an enemy adjacent to <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Exitor-Rho</style> is attacked by another friendly <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> unit, <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Exitor-Rho</style> deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Energy">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Energy Damage</style> to that enemy. If an enemy adjacent to <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Exitor-Rho</style> is defeated by a friendly <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> unit or an attack triggered from this ability, <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Exitor-Rho</style> moves onto its hex.

OrbsOfDecay.description: The relic bearer's <style="NormalAttack">normal attacks</style> deal an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Toxic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage</style> to enemy units that have their <style="Stat_Armor">Armour</style> reduced by {[armorReductionPct]}% or more and are also on or adjacent to the target's hex. Additionally, the target's hex is <style="Tile_Contamination">Contaminated</style>.

PathOfCommand.description: Other friendly units within {[range]} hexes gain <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style>. Their <style="Stat_CritDamage">Crit <style="Stat_Chance">chance</style></style> – if they have one – is increased by <style="Stat">+{[extraCritChance]}%</style>. Affected <style="Faction_Aeldari">Aeldari</style> units gain an additional <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg_2]} Damage</style>.

PhaeronOfTheBlades.description: All adjacent <style="Faction_Necrons">Necrons</style> deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> with melee attacks.

PhaeronOfTheStars.description: All adjacent <style="Faction_Necrons">Necrons</style> deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> with ranged attacks.

Phantasm.description: As long as there is a Phantasm, all incoming damage is reduced by <style="Stat_Damage">{[dmgReductionPct]}%</style>. If <style="Faction_Aeldari">Eldryon</style> becomes the target of an attack when there is no Phantasm, he moves to a random free hex and leaves a Phantasm behind, preferring hexes within range <style="Stat">3</style> if possible. This movement can traverse impassable hexes and enemies and move between any elevation. When a unit moves onto the Phantasm it is destroyed and <style="Faction_Aeldari">Eldryon</style> loses <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style>.

PinpointCounterOffensive.description: <style="Faction_Tau">Re'vas</style> can use her active ability {[maxNrOfActivations]} times per Battle. Additionally, she takes <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> from all attacks, but loses <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style> each time she is attacked by a unit with either the <style="Infiltrate">Infiltrate</style> or <style="Terminator_Armor">Terminator Armour</style> traits, or by a unit that has <style="Buff_Infiltrate">Infiltrate</style> from an ability.

PlasmaCannon.description:
Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Plasma">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage</style> to an enemy within range {[range]} and up to two enemy units behind the target. This ability can be used multiple times per battle but has a <style="Cooldown">cooldown of {[cooldownTurns]} round.</style> 

<style="Cooldown">Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round</style>.

PoundThemToDust.description: Performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal attack</style> and then marks an area of up to 7 hexes. At the beginning of its next turn, the <style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Rogal Dorn Battle Tank</style> deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Heavy">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage</style> to all units in the marked area.

PowerTrip.description: <style="NormalAttack">Normal attacks</style> ignore <style="Stat_Armor">{[armorIgnored]} Armour</style>. If <style="Faction_Orks">Snappawrecka</style> is at full <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>, his <style="NormalAttack">normal attacks</style> additionally score <style="Stat_Hits">+{[extraHit]} hit</style> and reduce the target's Armour by <style="Stat_Armor">{[armorReduction]} Armour</style>, but also cause <style="Faction_Orks">Snappawrecka</style> to lose <style="Stat">{[hpPct]}%</style> of his maximum <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>.

Poxwalkers.description:
Summons <style="Summon"><style="Faction_DeathGuard">Poxwalkers</style></style> in <style="Stat_Chance">{[chance]}-{[chance_2]}%</style> of free hexes (rounded up) within <style="Faction_DeathGuard">Corrodius'</style> <style="ContagionsOfNurgle">Contagion</style> aura. Newly summoned <style="Summon"><style="Faction_DeathGuard">Poxwalkers</style></style> immediately attack in <style="Stat_Melee">melee</style>, but cannot move this turn.

Poxwalker’s stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>

PreCalibratedPurgeSolution.description: If <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Belisarius Cawl</style> has at least <style="Stat">{[effectLevel]}</style> levels of <style="Buff_MachineVengeance">Machine Vengeance</style> at the start of his turn, he deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Toxic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage</style> to all enemies on the battlefield.

PrehensilePincerTail.description: When the Hive Tyrant attacks an enemy in melee, that target or an enemy unit adjacent to both the target and the Hive Tyrant takes <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Physical">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage</style>.

PrimarchOfTheFirstLegion.description: Half of the <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style> (rounded down) scored against <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Lion El'Jonson</style> are scored against other friendly adjacent <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Dark Angels</style> instead. Friendly Dark Angels that take <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> this way deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> for {[nrOfRounds]} round.

PriorityReclamation.description: While there is an <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Archeotec Crate</style> on the battlefield, <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Actus</style> receives <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style>, but loses <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style> each time an enemy destroys an Archeotec Crate. At the end of his turn, if Actus is adjacent to an Archeotec Crate, he removes one Archeotec Crate and all friendly <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> units gain <style="Stat">{[effectLevel]}</style> levels of <style="Buff_MachineVengeance">Machine Vengeance</style>.

ProperKilly.description: Always eager to engage the toughest foe, <style="Faction_Orks">Ghazghkull</style>'s melee attack prioritises the unit with the highest current health total. He slashes with Gork's Klaw, attacking all enemies in the 3 hexes in front of him. Each target takes <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]} hit</style> that deals {[dmgPct]}% of their <style="Stat_Health">Max Health</style> as <style="DMG_Power">Power Damage</style>. When damage is dealt this way, each target hit is also <style="Debuff_Stunned">Stunned</style> for 1 round. Afterwards each target is hit with <style="Faction_Orks">Ghazghkull</style>'s <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attack</style>.

ProphetOfGorkAndMork.description: After being attacked <style="Stat">{[nrOfAttacks]}</style> times in a turn, <style="Faction_Orks">Ghazghkull</style> takes <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgPctReduction]}% Damage</style> until the end of that turn.

PsychicDominion.description: <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Magnus</style> takes  <style="DMG_Psychic">-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Psychic Damage</style> and <style="Psyker">Psykers</style> receive <style="Stat_Damage">+{[dmgPct]}% Damage</style> from his attacks.

PsychicMaelstrom.description:
Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> to a target within {[range]} hexes. <style="Stat_Chance">{[chance]}% chance</style> to score another <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style>.

RadZoneCorps.description:
At the beginning of <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Tan Gi'Da's</style> turn, he deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Toxic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage</style> to each enemy that has their <style="Stat_Armor">Armour</style> reduced. At the end of his turn, he summons <style="Stat">{[nrOfSummons]}</style> <style="Summon"><style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Skitarii Vanguard</style></style> at the top of the map and <style="Tile_Contamination">Contaminates</style> one row of hexes on the battlefield.

Skitarii Vanguard stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

ReapingScythe.description: Attacks a unit in melee by swinging Silence in a wide arc, hitting the target and all enemy units adjacent to the target for <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Chain">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Chain Damage</style>. Mortarion prefers to target <style="Psyker">Psykers</style> with this ability.

RedemptionOfTheRisen.description: Each time a friendly <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Dark Angel</style> is defeated by a <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> enemy, <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Forcas</style> loses <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style>. If a friendly Dark Angel is defeated during the enemy turn, Forcas and all friendly Dark Angels start <style="Buff_Overwatching">Overwatching</style>. As long as there is another friendly Dark Angel on the battlefield, Forcas and friendly adjacent Dark Angels take <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style>.

ReinforcedHiveNode.description: Every second round – starting from the first the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Tyranid Warrior</style> is in play – the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Tyranid Warrior</style> has <style="Stat_Armor">+100% Armour</style> and – if it has <style="Stat_Block">Block</style> – 100% <style="Stat_Block">Block <style="Stat_Chance">chance</style></style>.

Reinforcements.description: At the start of <style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Sibyll Devine’s</style> turn, <style="STAT">{[nrOfSummons]}</style> <style="Summon"><style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Cadian Guardsmen</style></style> are summoned at the top of the map and immediately take a turn. Each time a friendly <style="Summon"><style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Cadian Guardsman</style></style> is defeated, <style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Sibyll Devine</style> is dealt <style="DMG_Psychic">{[dmg]} Psychic Damage</style>.

RelentlessMarch.description: Gives +1 <style="Stat_Movement">Movement</style> to all friendly units that start their turn in an adjacent hex. Also <style="Repairing">repairs</style> affected <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> units for <style="Stat_Health">{[hpToRepair]} Health</style>.

RelicOfLostCadia.description: Friendly surrounding <style="Aliance_Imperial">Imperial</style> <style="Summon">Summons</style> have <style="FinalJustice">Final Vengeance</style>. When the relic bearer is defeated, summons a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Cadian Guardsman</style></style> in its hex with <style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>, <style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style> and <style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>.

RevitalizingMalignancy.description: <style="Healing">Heals</style> himself and all adjacent friendly units for <style="Stat_Health">{[hpToHeal]} Health</style>, and an additional <style="Stat_Health">+{[hpToHeal_2]} Health</style> to <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> units. <style="Aliance_Imperial">Imperial</style> units do not receive any <style="Healing">healing</style>.

RevoltinglyResilient.description: When attacked, each hit after the first {[nrOfHits]} hits in that same attack deals {[dmgPctReduction]}% less Damage than the previous hit. The first {[nrOfHits]} hits of each attack deal normal damage, the next hit 50% damage, the next hit 25%, etc.

ScreamerInvocation.description:
The first time there are no allied <style="Daemon">Daemons</style> on the battlefield at the end of his turn, <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Abraxas</style> summons <style="Stat">{[nrOfSummons]}</style> <style="Summon"><style="Faction_ThousandSons">Screamers</style></style> onto random hexes on the battlefield. When a friendly Daemon is defeated, Abraxas loses <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style>. As long as there are friendly Daemons on the battlefield, all incoming damage to Abraxas is reduced by <style="Stat_Damage">{[dmgReductionPct]}%</style>.

Screamer of Tzeentch stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>

ScytheOfDust.description: <style="Faction_Necrons">Mesophet</style> does a mighty sweep with his scythe, dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Energy">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Energy Damage</style> to all enemies in adjacent hexes.

ScythingTalons.description:
Attacks an enemy in melee for <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Bio">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bio Damage</style> and any enemy units adjacent to that target and to the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Tyranid Warrior</style> take <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Bio">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bio Damage</style>. 

Double hits against <style="Summon">Summons</style>.

SelfRepairMechanismReworked.description: Beginning with the end of round <style="Stat">{[nrOfRounds]}</style>, at the end of each of his turns, <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Belisarius Cawl</style> gains <style="Stat_Armor">+ {[extraArmor]} Armour</style> for each level of <style="Buff_MachineVengeance">Machine Vengeance</style> he has.

SentinelDirectives.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage to an enemy unit within range {[range]} and Suppresses it for 1 round. Cannot be used if there is an enemy adjacent to Sy-Gex. Using Sentinel Directives does not end Sy-Gex's turn and he can still enter Overwatch this turn, unless he performs a normal attack.

ShroudPsalm.description: Up to {[nrOfTargets]} other friendly units gain {[effectLevel]} levels of Machine Vengeance and are affected by Shroud Psalm until the start of their next turn. Affected units have +{[extraArmor]} Armour and normal attacks against them score -{[hitsReduction]} hits, to a minimum of 1.

SmashaEad.description: When he traverses 2 or more hexes during his turn, then <style="Faction_Orks">Tanksmasha</style> gains <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> for <style="NormalAttack">normal attacks</style> and takes <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> until the start of his next turn.

SolarAtomizer.description: Transfers all levels of <style="Buff_MachineVengeance">Machine Vengeance</style> from other friendly <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> units to <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Belisarius Cawl</style>. Additionally <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Belisarius Cawl</style> faces in one of 6 directions and marks all hexes in a straight line 2 hexes wide. At the beginning of his next turn, deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Melta">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Melta Damage</style> to all enemies on affected hexes.

SoulHunger.description:
Enemy Psykers take <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> when using Active abilities or Smite within {[range]} hexes from the Hive Tyrant.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

SpawnTermagants.description:
Summons 1-{[maxSummons]} <style="Summon">Termagants</style>, starting with the hex in front of the Tervigon and then propagating to free hexes from there.

Termagant’s stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

SpawnTermagants2.description:
Summons 1-{[maxSummons]} <style="Summon">Termagants</style>, starting with the hex in front of the Tervigon and then propagating to free hexes from there.

Termagant’s stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

SpawnTermagants3.description:
Summons 1-{[maxSummons]} <style="Summon">Termagants</style>, starting with the hex in front of the Tervigon and then propagating to free hexes from there.

Termagant’s stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

SpiritLeech.description:
Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> to an enemy unit within {[range]} hexes. If the target is <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style>, deals an additional <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style>, otherwise <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppresses</style> it. The <style="Faction_Tyranids">Neurothrope</style> <style="Healing">heals</style> itself and friendly <style="Faction_Tyranids">Tyranids</style> adjacent to it for <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> equal to <style="STAT">{[hpToHealPct]}%</style> of the total damage dealt with this ability.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

SpotterReworked.description: Other friendly units within {[range]} hexes deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> with ranged attacks. Affected units with <style="Heavy_Weapon">Heavy Weapon</style> deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg_2]} Damage</style> with ranged attacks instead.

SquigHound.description:
Friendly <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Orks">Grots</style></style> ignore <style="Battle_Fatigue">Battle Fatigue</style>. <style="Faction_Orks">Snotflogga</style>'s <style="NormalAttack">normal attacks</style> deal an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Physical">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage</style>. After attacking, if there are less than <style="Stat">{[maxSummons]}</style> friendly <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Orks">Grots</style></style> on the battlefield, they summon a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Orks">Grot</style></style> adjacent to the target that immediately can attack.

Grot’s stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>

StaffOfStars.description: Hapthatra unleashes the full power of the Staff of Stars, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Energy Damage to an initial target and {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Energy Damage to all enemies adjacent to that target. Summons take double Damage.

StranglethornCannon.description: The Hive Tyrant attacks using its Stranglethorn Cannon, dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to an initial target within {[range]} hexes. Any units adjacent to the target suffer <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Blast Damage</style>.

SupaCyborkBody.description: The relic bearer can be <style="Healing">healed</style> as well as <style="Repairing">repaired</style> and additionally takes <style="Stat_CritDamage">-{[critDmgReduction]} Crit Damage</style> for each adjacent enemy unit.

SynapticBacklash.description: Whenever the Tervigon sustains a <style="Stat_CritDamage">Crit</style>, friendly Termagants within {[range]} hexes are also dealt {[dmgPct]}% of that attack’s <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style>.

SynapticImperative.description: All friendly units adjacent to this unit have a <style="Stat_Chance">{[chance]}% chance</style> to be revived at <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style> when suffering lethal <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style>, unless <style="Overkill">Overkilled</style>. This can only happen once per unit per turn.

SynapticLinchpin.description:
Whenever the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Winged Prime</style>, or another friendly unit with <style="Synapse">Synapse</style>, performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal attack</style> against an enemy and that enemy is not defeated, summons a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Tyranids">Hormagaunt</style></style> adjacent to the target, which immediately attacks the enemy. Cannot have more than <style="STAT">{[maxSummons]}</style> <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Tyranids">Hormagaunts</style></style> summoned this way at the same time.

Hormagaunt stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

TaintedNarthecium.description: An adjacent friendly <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> unit that is defeated has a <style="Stat_Chance">{[chance]}% chance</style> to be revived with a maximum of <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style>, even if <style="Overkill">Overkilled</style>. Can only be triggered once per turn.

TargetingProtocols.description: Sets up to fire on {[nrOfTargets]} hexes. These hexes light up with light pillars and at the start of the <style="Faction_Necrons">Menhir</style>'s next turn any unit in those hexes is hit by an Annihilator Beam and is dealt <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Piercing">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage</style>.

TargetLock.description: At the beginning of the <style="Faction_Tau">Riptide</style>'s turn, it deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to all enemy units with a <style="Debuff_Markerlight">Markerlight</style>.

TheBloodyHanded.description: Other friendly <style="Faction_Aeldari">Aeldari</style> units are <style="Unstoppable">Unstoppable</style> and deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> against enemies standing on <style="Effect_Fire">Fire</style>.

TheEmperorsShield.description: Each hit scored by a <style="Stat_Melee">melee attack</style> against <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Lion El'Jonson</style> increases his <style="Stat_Block">Block</style> <style="Stat_Chance">chance</style> by <style="Stat">+{[blockChance]}%</style> until the end of this turn. Every time Lion El'Jonson blocks <style="Stat">{[nrOfAttacks]}</style> or more <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style> of a <style="Stat_Melee">melee attack</style> against him, he deals <style={[DamageProfileTypeStyle]}>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} {[DamageProfileType]}</style> to the attacker.

TheLantern.description:
Conjures a miasma of pestilence in one of six directions that fills a 3x3 hex area adjacent to <style="Faction_DeathGuard">Mortarion</style>. Enemy units hit by the miasma are <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style>. At the beginning of <style="Faction_DeathGuard">Mortarion</style>'s next turn he fires The Lantern's beam in an arc over the affected area, dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Energy">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Energy Damage</style> to each enemy unit in the area.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

TheLionsWrath.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style={[DamageProfileTypeStyle]}>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} {[DamageProfileType]}</style> to an adjacent enemy unit and <style="Debuff_Taunted">Taunts</style> it for {[nrOfRounds]} round. At the beginning of his next turn, if the targeted unit is still adjacent to <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Lion El'Jonson</style>, he deals  <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style={[DamageProfileTypeStyle_2]}>{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} {[DamageProfileType_2]}</style> to it. All attacks triggered by this ability have a <style="Stat">{[chance]}% Chance</style> to score a <style="Stat_CritDamage">Crit</style> with their second <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style>, even if the first <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style> did not score a <style="Stat_CritDamage">Crit</style>.

TheWailingDoomStrikes.description: Faces in one of 6 directions and sets all hexes in a straight line 2 hexes wide and originating from the Avatar of Khaine on <style="Effect_Fire">Fire</style>, dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Flame">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage</style> to all enemies on affected hexes. At the beginning of its next turn, deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Melta">{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Melta Damage</style> to all enemies on affected hexes.

TheWailingDoomSweeps.description: Faces in one of 6 directions and sets a cone of hexes in range 2 in front of it on <style="Effect_Fire">Fire</style>, dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Flame">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage</style> to all enemies on affected hexes. At the beginning of its next turn, deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Melta">{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Melta Damage</style> to all enemies on affected hexes.

TheWildHost.description:
Reduces all incoming damage by <style="Stat_Damage">{[dmgReductionPct]}%</style>. <style="Faction_Aeldari">Aethana</style> loses <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style> each time she is attacked. At the beginning of <style="Faction_Aeldari">Aethana</style>'s turn, units on marked hexes take <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Projectile">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage</style>, and she marks all hexes of units that attacked her last turn.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

TheWrathfulDead.description: On each of his turns, {[nrOfSummons]} <style="Summon"><style="Faction_DeathGuard">Poxwalkers</style></style> spawn on the map in random free hexes, preferring hexes that are not adjacent to enemy <style="Character">Characters</style>. The spawned <style="Summon"><style="Faction_DeathGuard">Poxwalkers</style></style> don't move on the turn they are summoned, but will attack a target in range if there is one. Any time a friendly unit is defeated, <style="Faction_DeathGuard">Corrodius</style> also takes <style="DMG_Direct">Direct Damage</style> equal to {[healthPct]}% of the defeated unit's maximum <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>.

TheWrathOfKhaineUnleashedReworked.description: At the beginning of the <style="Faction_Aeldari">Avatar of Khaine</style>'s next turn, he deals <style="DMG_Flame">Flame Damage</style> to all enemies within {[range]} hexes, except enemies on healing hexes. This attack deals <style="DMG_Flame">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage</style> per <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style> and scores <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]} hits</style> against surrounding enemies, <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]} hits</style> against enemies at range {[range_2]}, and <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_3]} hits</style> against enemies at range {[range]}. Then all <style="Effect_Fire">Fire</style> in the affected area is extinguished, and all adjacent enemies are <style="Displacement">pushed</style> one hex.

TreasonOfTzeentch.description:
Creates a copy of an enemy character in a random hex within 3 hexes of <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Magnus</style>. The copy fights on the side of Magnus and has <style="Stat">{[hpPct]}%</style> of the original character's maximum <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>. All other stats and ability levels are identical.
When a character attacks Magnus while the clone of that character is on the battlefield, the character and the clone swap places.

TzeentchsFirestorm.description:
Marks all hexes exactly {[range_2]} hexes away from <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Magnus</style> in a ring around him. At the beginning of his next turn, all enemy units on marked hexes receive <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x </style> <style="DMG_Flame">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage</style>. For the next 2 turns, the process repeats, reducing the ring radius by {[range]} and increasing hits to enemies in marked hexes by <style="Stat_Hits">{[extraHits]}</style> each turn. Magnus can move independently of the ring after the initial turn of casting.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

UnbridledCarnageReworked.description: At the end of <style="Faction_Orks">Tanksmasha's</style> turn, <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Orks">Grots</style></style> and <style="Object2">Explosive Oil Drums</style> rain from the sky. If an Explosive Oil Drum gets destroyed, it explodes, damaging units on adjacent hexes. Tanksmasha loses <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style> from the explosion and all other characters take <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]} hit</style> that inflicts <style="DMG_Blast">Blast Damage</style> equal to {[dmgPct]}% of the character's maximum <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>. All affected <style="Summon">Summons</style> are destroyed.

UnparalleledFerocity.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Physical">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage</style> to all adjacent enemies, with a <style="Stat">100% Crit Chance</style> against<style="Summon">Summons</style>.

UnstoppableMomentumReworked.description:
Charges in one of 6 directions and keeps moving in a straight line until he hits an obstacle or a <style="Big_Target">Big Target</style>. Any enemies hit by the charge take <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Direct">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage</style>, increased by <style="Stat_Damage">{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> for each hex traversed from the starting hex to the enemy. Affected enemies get <style="Displacement">pushed</style> and <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style> for 1 round. A <style="Big_Target">Big Target</style> is <style="Debuff_Stunned">Stunned</style> for 1 round instead. Friendly units are also displaced, but take no damage or negative effects.

Initial <style="Cooldown">cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round</style>.

VulnerableToFlameAndBlast.description: Each time this unit is dealt <style="DMG_Flame">Flame Damage</style> or <style="DMG_Blast">Blast Damage</style>, it loses <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style> in addition to the damage done. This unit takes <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> from hits that do not deal <style="DMG_Flame">Flame Damage</style> or <style="DMG_Blast">Blast Damage</style>.

VulnerableToMelee.description: Each time this unit is dealt Damage by a <style="Stat_Melee">Melee attack</style>, it loses <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style> in addition to the damage done. This unit takes <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> from attacks that are not <style="Stat_Melee">Melee attacks</style>.

WeakerRearArmour.description: If enemies are inside the rear arc of the <style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Rogal Dorn Battle Tank</style>, their attacks have <style="Stat">+{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance</style> against it.
